scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bizznex/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @bizznex/api" "npm run dev -w @bizznex/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bizznex/shared && npm run build -w @bizznex/api && npm run build -w @bizznex/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bizznex/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @bizznex/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
